title: D5-5a N01: Maximum Safe Recovery for High-Sulfate Summer Seawater
question_prompt: An RO plant is proposed to operate at 48% system recovery. Classify this point as normal, warning, or critical under the applicable site operating policy, and state whether unchanged operation is acceptable. The policy bands are not provided in this question and are not outputs of the process simulator.
reference_answer:
D5-5a N01: Stepwise Gold Answer — Maximum Safe Recovery for High-Sulfate Summer Seawater
